title: Game Night Seating Plan (optional)

stageA.goals: Make choices and assumptions. Represent data using scaled bar graphs to communicate results. Solve real-world problems involving equal groups.
stageA.originalWarmup: Six groups of four dots around six square tables. Source artwork not copied.
stageA.originalSeatingRule: One person can sit on each exposed side of each square table; joined sides are blocked
